sourceFile: 09. BRS-161016 GMI Report  TF improve NG -05.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it merges unrelated workbook tests under a nonsensical changed-factor comparison.
issues: Changed factor mixes bonding, dates, frame, tray, yoke, and ED mold contexts.
Review title and purpose do not match the selected outcomes.
Multiple independent tests are forced into one review case.
Baseline and test conditions are ambiguous or unsupported for many outcomes.
Several measurement groupings misread IDs, molds, and headers as statistics.
correctionPlan: Rebuild review cases by explicit worksheet section and test purpose.
Define one changed-factor context per comparable test table.
Keep date, line, mold, jig, machine, lot, and type as subgroup keys.
Remove derived measurement stats that are header or identifier artifacts.
Cite header, condition, result, and decision rows for each case.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations do not sufficiently support the draft grouping or changed factor.
